entities.name: Vladimír Jiránek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimír Jiránek was a Czech illustrator, cartoonist and director of animated films. Most of his work was intended for an adult audience, but his best-known works are the animated series for children Pat & Mat and Bob a Bobek – králíci z klobouku.
